name: AIPersonalize360
author: PureDevs

sections.description:
AIPersonalize360 takes your eCommerce store to the next level by dynamically displaying personalized product recommendations. Whether you want to showcase top-rated, best-selling, or on-sale products, our plugin adapts to user interactions to present the most relevant items to your customers. Future-ready, the plugin plans to integrate AI to make recommendations even smarter.

Features include:
– Showcase products based on average ratings, total sales, and on-sale items.
– Highlight on-sale items and trending products.
– Shortcodes for seamless integration into any part of your site.

With AIPersonalize360, store admins can effortlessly display tailored content to enhance the user shopping experience and drive conversions.
sections.installation:
Installing AIPersonalize360 is quick and easy:

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Unzip and upload the aipersonalize360 folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin via the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the plugin settings to configure your preferences and display options.
sections.faq:
Q. Can this plugin work with WooCommerce?

A: Yes, AIPersonalize360 is fully compatible with WooCommerce and works seamlessly with WooCommerce product data.

Q. How do I display product recommendations on my site?

A: Use the provided shortcodes to place personalized product lists anywhere on your site. Shortcode examples are available in the plugin settings.
